title: You’re Using AI Wrong on Your Resume (And Recruiters Can Tell)
description:
Most job seekers are using AI to write their resume the wrong way — and recruiters can tell immediately.

AI isn’t the problem. Generic prompting is.

Instead of letting ChatGPT write your resume for you, use it to decode the role, identify what the employer actually needs, and align your real experience to those priorities.

transcript: If you're using AI to write your resume, you're probably killing your chances. And no, not because AI doesn't work. It's because most people are using AI at the wrong level, and recruiters can tell immediately. Most job seekers are letting AI write for them instead of thinking with them. That's how you end up with generic AI language that quietly sends your application straight into the no pile. One of the smartest ways to use AI is to not ask it to write anything at all. is to force AI to think like a recruiter. Before you touch your resume, ask AI what this role is actually hiring for, the real problems a job is meant to solve, the priorities, and what makes a candidate credible at a glance. Then past your real experience and ask AI which of those experience directly solve those problems and make sure those achievements show up at the top.
